profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that describes itself as a commercial-stage global developer of autonomous driving technology spanning Level 2 to Level 4. Its site presents the WeRide One universal autonomous driving platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. The company says its business footprint covers more than 60 cities across 13 countries, and it offers a portfolio of five core products, of which Robotaxi is the one named on the site.

The company trades under the ticker WRD on Nasdaq and is also listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. Its site states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. A US filing record under CIK 0001867729 is associated with the company, and an ADR alias, WERIDE INC-ADR, is also recorded.

No litigation, no tracked product entries, and no MCP servers are recorded for WeRide in the material available here.
